Netanagri Full Video:
The countdown to the Uttar Pradesh elections has begun. It is also believed that an alliance between the Samajwadi Party and the Congress is a certainty, although the Congress wishes to contest at least 100 seats. At the same time, SP is insisting that Congress should contest only those seats where it has a higher chance of winning. Meanwhile, the biggest question is: is the Congress a necessity for Akhilesh Yadav, or a compulsion?
